title: Blue Book's Robert Friend sees the channeling session; told another agency has it

tellings.quote: And then the general says another agency has it hands off. And we never hear anything more.

plain: In July 1959, an Air Force officer named Robert Friend, then in charge of Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, watched a session in Washington where someone claimed to receive messages from beings elsewhere, with an official named Arthur Lundahl also involved. When Friend took it up the chain, a general told him another agency had it and to keep his hands off, and nothing more was ever heard. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells Michels this, drawing on an 11-page memo about the meeting of July 9, 1959, and he tells it as a sign that someone other than the Air Force held the real UFO file.
